question: Which two topics are assigned to the twenty-fourth ecstasy section?
premises: caturviṃśatike'pi+ca places both in the twenty-fourth section
inference: The twenty-fourth section treats substance-distinction and śakti-purification.
uncertainties: exact scope of dravyābheda is not specified beyond the heading
plain_english: In the twenty-fourth section, substance-distinction and śakti-purification are treated.
